title: Secondo uno studio dell'università di Urbino l'algoritmo di Facebook ora punisce la politica ufficiale e premia gli estremisti antieuropei. Pd e FdI verso una legge bipartisan sulle piattaforme
snippet: The article reports on the publication of a major study by Professor Fabio Giglietto analyzing over 2.5 million Facebook posts. It highlights his findings on the asymmetric impact of Meta's algorithmic policies, which penalized official institutional politics in Italy by cutting their reach while allowing far-right and extremist content to expand their footprint.
description: An article reporting on a major study led by Professor Fabio Giglietto from the University of Urbino, which analyzes how Facebook's algorithm penalizes official political accounts while boosting extremist content.
